data.action: 仰头立于花帘下，花瓣落发，转身浅笑藏悲
data.camera: medium shot, wisteria canopy, petal light, bittersweet mood
data.description: 【藤园·满开午后】紫藤花帘垂落如瀑，忍站在花架下仰头让花影落在脸上。她忽然开口，声音轻得像花瓣——「紫藤花的毒对鬼致命……对我也一样哦。所以呐，在我还笑得出来的日子里……要一起看更多、更多的花才行。」转过身来，微笑之下第一次露出了真实的悲伤。
data.lighting: 紫藤花帘过滤的淡紫光
data.promptProse: Shinobu turns from the hanging wisteria toward the viewer, a trace of sadness held in her small smile. Sunlight filters through the violet flowers and falls in soft patches over her shoulders.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 紫藤花下的秘密·「紫藤花的毒，对鬼和对我都一样呢」
data.animaCaption: She turns from the hanging wisteria toward the viewer with sadness held within her small smile.
